summary: scripts/review: runs an agent CLI (claude, codex or omp, chosen in .st/review-harness.json) over git diff main...HEAD with docs/review.md, computes the deterministic risk floor and per-file patch-ids itself, reads only what changed since an earlier verdict (and carries a verdict over a clean merge of main without a model call), assembles the verdict, validates it with scripts/review-validate and writes it with cost and time measurements. A verdict that does not validate is not written.

replay.detail: scripts/review, .st/review-harness.json and scripts/review-test (local review tooling) only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change. The script appends verdicts to review-records/ inside the repository's git directory; nothing else reads them.
